# Phishing Simulation Exercise for Black Hat Europe 2024

## Objective
The goal of this exercise is to educate participants about phishing attacks, their methodologies, and how to implement a phishing simulation in a controlled lab environment. By the end of this workshop, participants will understand the technical aspects of creating a phishing email and a landing page to capture credentials.

## Scenario Overview
In this exercise, participants will simulate a phishing attack targeting employees of a fictional company, "TechCorp." The phishing email will impersonate the company's IT department, prompting users to verify their login credentials due to a supposed security breach.
